articles.title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
articles.description:
The measure seeks to facilitate the completion of construction on the hospital that was damaged by devastating floods in 2020.

articles.title: Boat capsizes in New York Harbor, woman and 5-month-old baby die
articles.description:
Twelve people were rescued from the water before police arrived, and police divers later located the 27-year-old woman and 5-month-old girl in the water.

The post Boat capsizes in New York Harbor, woman and 5-month-old baby die appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Boat capsized in New York Harbor, resulting in two fatalities.

Boston residents may face increased safety regulations for boating activities following this tragedy.

articles.title: Don Nelson, second-winningest NBA coach who won 5 titles as a Celtics player, dies at 86
articles.description:
Nelson played 11 of his 14 seasons in Boston and was on five Celtics championship teams under four different coaches.

The post Don Nelson, second-winningest NBA coach who won 5 titles as a Celtics player, dies at 86 appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Don Nelson, former Celtics player and coach, passed away at 86 on August 9, 2026.
He won five championships with the Celtics during his 14-season NBA career.
Nelson's legacy influences Boston's basketball culture and honors the team's rich history.
